hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command' | head -1 | grep -qF 'git commit'; then npm test 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Tests are failing. Fix the failing tests before committing.' >&2; exit 2; else echo 'All tests passed. Proceeding with commit.'; fi; fi
